remarks:
Build your dream home or private mountain retreat on this beautiful slopeside lot with direct ski-in, ski-out
access to Swain Resort. Nestled on approximately half an acre, this mountainside property offers the perfect blend of peace, privacy, and year-round recreation. Electric is already available on-site, and sewer access is available at the road. Buyer will need to install a grinder pump. Whether you're looking for a vacation escape, or full-time residence, this scenic property delivers stunning views, quiet surroundings, and unbeatable access to the slopes. Enjoy four seasons of outdoor adventure in a serene setting where nature and convenience come together.
facts: Irregular Lot, Subdivision, Secluded, Gentle Sloping, Wooded
